notes: Modern Standard Arabic. Address the user directly in the second person singular (masculine imperative, the standard convention in Arabic software: «احفظ»، «اختر»); buttons and menu items use verbal nouns (حفظ، إلغاء، إعادة التسمية), headings use nouns. Use Arabic punctuation (، ؛ ؟) and «guillemets» for quoted UI names; keep the English em dash (—) in error messages. Arabic has no capitals, so no capitalisation scheme. Keep Western digits (1, 2, 100%) as the code inserts them. Error toasts follow "تعذّر …" + "— حاول مرة أخرى". Names of options on English-only third-party sites (Lulu, Google Fonts) stay in English inside «». Chapter = الأصحاح (Van Dyck usage); books of the Bible = الأسفار; interior = الصفحات الداخلية; double-sided = على الوجهين; long/short edge = الحافة الطويلة/القصيرة. Printed book text: Formal Modern Standard Arabic as printed in published Arabic Bibles. Chapter heading uses الأصحاح (Van Dyck usage) with Western digits; licensing statements use the permissive modal يجوز; public domain = الملك العام; Arabic punctuation (، ؛ ؟) and «guillemets».
